svg.text: Assembly seating for 75 — the permitted ceiling for this room
12 sq ft per person at 900 sq ft
Chairs face the north focal wall
CROSS CIRCULATION — POSTS FALL IN THIS BAND
900 sq ft / 75 = 12 sq ft per person
Four 4'-6" aisles run to the single west entry
6 seats per block — well under the 14-seat limit
Rows sit clear of the posts: the centerline falls
inside the 4'-3" cross band, so no chair is blocked.
Clear width past each post narrows to ~1'-7", so the
cross band is row access only — egress is the side aisles.
